english.title: Make off from a prison while subject to a s.86A(2)(b) requirement to await the arrival of a constable - CJA 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who

(A)_[was in]_
(B)_[seeking to enter]_

a prison, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRISON..), failed to comply with a requirement to wait for the arrival of a constable by **(.. SPECIFY THE NAME..), a prisoner custody officer performing custodial duties at that prison,

(C)_[he]_
(D)_[she]_

having reason to believe you were or had been committing an offence under section **(..SPECIFY ANY OF THE SECTIONS 39 TO 40D..) of the Prison Act 1952, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 86A(3) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person who was in/seeking to enter a prison
failed to comply with a requirement to wait for the arrival of a constable
by a prisoner custody officer performing custodial duties at that prison
he/she having reason to believe that you were/had been committing an offence under the Prison Act 1952

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted onto the Criminal Justice Act 1991 by section 17(1) of the Offender Management Act 2007.
(ii) Section 86A(4) of the Criminal Justice Act 1991, as inserted by section 17 of the Offender management Act 2007, provides;-
"In subsection 86A(2), a reference to an offence under a particular provision includes a reference to any offence consisting of an attempt to commit, incitement or conspiracy to commit, or aiding, abetting, counselling or procuring the commission of, an offence under that provision."
